scope: Exploratory numerical sensitivity on the existing full-item B-half captured responses; no new data and no learner bootstrap. Not preregistered or recovery of historical convergence.

settings.interpretation: Gaussian item prior SD=2.5, posterior-mode criterion; different estimator

stopping: max item-parameter change <1e-4 AND relative objective change <1e-7 for 3 consecutive EM iterations; this is numerical stopping, not proof of global optimality or criterion validity
